title: Rue Guardians
summary: The Rue Guardians are a mysterious order of Seekers from the Casterwill family, who protect the family using ancient magic and curses. There are five Rue Guardians, with the Elder Rue Guardian serving as the leader of the other four.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
In ancient times, the Rue Guardians protected the Casterwill family with their curses. They created all kinds of dangerous Casterwill tests, including the Trial of Courage, the quest to find the Legendary Titan of Valour, Mythras. [Sophie on Trial]

When the Blue Star was activated, the five Rue Guardians were among the representatives of the Casterwill family who met at the Fortress of Iron Will. Their Elder, along with Focauld Casterwill, opposed the presence of Lok Lambert for not being a member of the family and voted against open confrontation with the Blood Spiral. [Sophie on Trial]

During the Blood Spiral's assault on the Fortress of Iron Will, the Rue Guardians worked with Focauld Casterwill an ancient incantation, simultaneously invoking Coralgolem, Feyone, and Icarus Amulets within the stronghold. [The Spiral War]

On the longest night of the year, five Rue Guardians travelled in a Scramjet to the Spiral Mark with the rest of the Huntik Foundation and Casterwill alliance. [The Spiral Mark] During the final battle against the Blood Spiral, they used their powerful magic to take out numerous Spiral forces in the air, much to LeBlanche's amazement. Following the defeat of the Betrayer, the Rue Guardians were seen coming to celebrate with the rest of their family. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Coralgolem — borrowed — Through an ancient ritual, the Guardians awoke the dormant Coralgolem within the Fortress of Iron Will to fight the Blood Spiral army.

Feyone x8 — borrowed — Through an ancient ritual, the Guardians awoke eight dormant Feyone statues within the Fortress of Iron Will to fight the Blood Spiral army.

Icarus x15 — borrowed — Through an ancient ritual, the Guardians awoke fifteen dormant Icarus statues within the Fortress of Iron Will to fight the Blood Spiral army.

The Rue Guardians are a mysterious order of Seekers from the Casterwill family, who protect the family using ancient magic and curses. There are five Rue Guardians, with the Elder Rue Guardian serving as the leader of the other four.
== History ==
In ancient times, the Rue Guardians protected the Casterwill family with their curses. They created all kinds of dangerous Casterwill tests, including the Trial of Courage, the quest to find the Legendary Titan of Valour, Mythras. [Sophie on Trial]

When the Blue Star was activated, the five Rue Guardians were among the representatives of the Casterwill family who met at the Fortress of Iron Will. Their Elder, along with Focauld Casterwill, opposed the presence of Lok Lambert for not being a member of the family and voted against open confrontation with the Blood Spiral. [Sophie on Trial]

During the Blood Spiral's assault on the Fortress of Iron Will, the Rue Guardians worked with Focauld Casterwill an ancient incantation, simultaneously invoking Coralgolem, Feyone, and Icarus Amulets within the stronghold. [The Spiral War]

On the longest night of the year, five Rue Guardians travelled in a Scramjet to the Spiral Mark with the rest of the Huntik Foundation and Casterwill alliance. [The Spiral Mark] During the final battle against the Blood Spiral, they used their powerful magic to take out numerous Spiral forces in the air, much to LeBlanche's amazement. Following the defeat of the Betrayer, the Rue Guardians were seen coming to celebrate with the rest of their family. [Dante's Return]

==Personality==
The Rue Guardians are a mysterious and mostly silent order. Although sinister in appearance and description, the Guardians have the best interests of the Casterwill family at heart.[Sophie on Trial]

==Abilities==
The Rue Guardians hold the secret knowledge of the Fortress of Iron Will and the Amulets hidden within. Together, the Rue Guardians are capable of summoning an army of Titans to their aid and creating powerful magic in tandem. [The Spiral War] In ancient times, the Rue Guardians created all kinds of dark incantations to protect the family's secrets, including the Fear Monsters of the Trial of Courage. [Sophie on Trial]
